tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Sections alternate crema and azul profundo (mar).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bento cells, cards, inputs on surface.

tokens.name: surface-invert
tokens.usage: A contrasting band inside a section (marquee, footer strip).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (above 13:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on either surface (above 6:1).

tokens.name: ink-invert
tokens.usage: Text on surface-invert.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Aguamarina, the brand accent. Fill for the primary CTA, stickers and the scroll thread on dark; text on it is on-accent. Never as text on crema.

tokens.name: mediterraneo
tokens.usage: Azul Mediterráneo: text, links, eyebrows, the hero signature and drawn lines on crema (above 6:1); on mar it becomes light aqua.

tokens.name: mediterraneo-fill
tokens.usage: Azul Mediterráneo as a large fill (hero shape behind the photo); text on it is ink-invert crema.

tokens.name: aqua-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind aqua details and placeholders.

tokens.name: cielo
tokens.usage: Sky-blue playful secondary fill: testimonial cell, stickers. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: cielo-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet sky tint for tags and highlights.

tokens.name: disponible
tokens.usage: Availability and positive states only (the pulsing dot).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on aqua, cielo and disponible fills (above 8:1).
